items: solar security camera (camera + panel sold as one SKU, Wi-Fi or 4G LTE)
why: Both ChatGPT answers frame the question as picking a camera type (Wi-Fi, 4G LTE, PTZ, multi-camera) and comparing specs like resolution, panel wattage, battery and connectivity; they name no second item the shopper must add, since the listed options (Reolink Argus 4 Pro Solar Kit, Arenti GO1 Solar Kit, AnywhereCam Eagle 4G Pro, Arenti GO3G with SIM included) already ship camera and panel together. The deciding fact is connectivity, Wi-Fi at the mounting spot versus cellular LTE for remote sites, plus a panel sized for cloudy days, and that is a model choice rather than a set, so a single comparison page that recommends one model fits.
